thread:
maria: Quick sync — catalog lift-off tomorrow morning. Two gating items: (1) license/model-card sign-off for new open models, (2) perf profiles + E2E evals for the canary set. Who's owning what?

sam: I have perf tables for wavereq7b and gulliver6b but 95p latency is a bit high on gulliver. Raw numbers (batch=1, a100):
```
wavereq7b 95p = 320ms
gulliver6b 95p = 480ms
```
kai: Kai here — infra can try increasing min-batch to 2 for gulliver on canary, that usually trims the tail. Can we tolerate the slightly higher avg compute?

anya: Legal flagged LlamaX-derived models: license requires attribution + a short usage clause in model card. Need someone to add the text to manifest and model-card before publish. Not a blocker for canary if model-card PR is open.

george: I can take the model-card + manifest PR. I'll create branch `catalog/gulliver6b-card` and open PR with the required attribution + short usage note. ETA 15:00 PT.

sam: Thanks george. Also need the long-tail QA eval run (our QA split) for gulliver — I can run it but need a staging slot and the eval harness config.

kai: Allocating staging slot now. Use this command to run locally in staging:
```
./scripts/run_eval --model gulliver6b --split longtail_qa --workers 4 --out results/gulliver_longtail.json
```
I'll bump the canary batch setting with `BATCH_MIN=2` and put it behind the canary route. infra-bot: will notify when done.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Can confirm a staging GPU slot reserved (slot-id: stg-49). Applying `BATCH_MIN=2` to canary pool; rolling update started.

sam: kicking off eval now on stg-49. Will post pass/fail + failure examples. If perf profile needs tuning we can add a quantized variant as fallback.

maria: Plan recap: george = model-card + license text; sam = perf + eval runs; kai = infra batch tweak + staging; anya/legal = final sign-off on manifest wording. If anything isn't green by 17:00 PT (5pm) we delay lift-off. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

legal-bot: legal-bot: Reminder — please include `license_attribution.md` link in manifest and add `license_summary` field (short string). Automated scan will re-run after PR is opened.

sam: noted — starting eval, pinging when results are in (will add sample failures if any).

kai: batch tweak rolled out to canary pools. quick check: 95p dropped ~180ms in internal run, but median CPU time rose ~5%. rolling: :rocket:

maria: awesome — thx all. Once sam posts eval + george opens PR, I'll schedule canary release at 18:00 UTC and watch metrics for 30m. Post results here and @mention me if you see regressions.
